# Contributing

This is an unofficial personal fork of
[Logisim-evolution](https://github.com/logisim-evolution/logisim-evolution), maintained by one
person as a set of small, additive workflow improvements. It does not run the same
open-issue-first, multi-reviewer process as the upstream project — see upstream's own
[contribution guide](https://github.com/logisim-evolution/logisim-evolution/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
if that is what you are looking for.

If you have a change for **this fork's own additions** (anything under "Where the fork's own code
lives" in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md)):

* Fork the repository.
* Put your work in a branch of **main**, not in `main` itself.
* Once done, open a pull request against **main**.
* If the change is more than a minor fix, add an entry to
  [`docs/peler-edition/CHANGELOG.md`](../docs/peler-edition/CHANGELOG.md) — this fork's own
  changelog. Leave [`CHANGES.md`](../CHANGES.md) alone; that file is upstream's own changelog for
  upstream's own history.

If you have a change for **unmodified upstream code**, please send it to
[upstream Logisim-evolution](https://github.com/logisim-evolution/logisim-evolution) instead, so it
reaches every downstream user rather than just this fork's.
